near_miss_definition.rule: Near-miss iff pad-aligned contact, not a landing, exactly one of {rotation==0, vy<0.15} fails, and that failure is within tolerance.

cells.player_mapping: Touch thrust slider continuous; setRotation ±10°/0 each decision (1 frame). Unlike keyboard, decisions every physics frame.
Same as keyboard-ish hold: one setRotation/thrust command held ~4 frames (≈67ms), near the 80ms keyboard rotate rate limit.
Command held 8 frames (~133ms); slower than keyboard max rotate rate.
Command held 16 frames (~267ms); player holding a key / not re-tapping.
Thrust in {0,0.25,0.5,1} (UP key is binary 0/1; touch is continuous — discrete bins are a coarsening of touch). Delta setRotation as above.
Touch absolute angle via setRotation to one of 19 bins (-90..90/10°), held 8 frames.
Action layout {-10,0,0,0,+10}: 3/5 mass on hold by layout (maps to releasing arrow keys), not NN bias. Held 8 frames.
